name: io.github.dukotah/tyto
description: AI-orchestrated penetration testing over MCP: a frontier model drives a 55-tool arsenal while a deterministic Scope Guard gates every action and a tamper-evident audit log records it. Authorized testing only.

packages.runtimeHint: Build the Go binary (go build ./cmd/tyto), then run: tyto mcp --engagement <file>. Requires a loaded engagement; the guard denies out-of-scope and over-ceiling actions.
